# BoxFleet

> Reference documentation for BoxFleet: guides, SDK references and the HTTP reference of one documentation build.

Documentation build `5e16c0150e0eb5af7a4ed86a0fa01dc08bc1aa416d727382b7d14a6ae579518e` (edition `5e16c0150e0e`), API version `0.3.0`. Every link below is the Markdown rendering of a page of this build; the same page exists as HTML next to it.

## HTTP reference

- [HTTP reference](http/index.md): published operations: 23
- [cancelJob](http/jobs/canceljob.md): POST /v1/jobs/{jobId}/cancel
- [createCloudBox](http/cloud/createcloudbox.md): POST /v1/cloud/boxes
- [describeAgentMods](http/system/describeagentmods.md): GET /v1/mods
- [getHealth](http/system/gethealth.md): GET /health
- [getJobExecution](http/jobs/getjobexecution.md): GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}/execution
- [getJobLogs](http/jobs/getjoblogs.md): GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}/logs
- [getJobStatus](http/jobs/getjobstatus.md): GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}
- [getOrganizationFleet](http/fleet/getorganizationfleet.md): GET /v1/organizations/{orgId}/fleet
- [getWhiteLabelCloudCatalog](http/cloud/getwhitelabelcloudcatalog.md): GET /v1/cloud/catalog
- [inspectProject](http/jobs/inspectproject.md): POST /v1/inspect
- [listCapabilities](http/system/listcapabilities.md): GET /v1/capabilities
- [listCloudBoxes](http/cloud/listcloudboxes.md): GET /v1/cloud/boxes
- [listJobs](http/jobs/listjobs.md): GET /v1/jobs
- [listOrganizationMembers](http/fleet/listorganizationmembers.md): GET /v1/organizations/{orgId}/members
- [listProviders](http/system/listproviders.md): GET /v1/providers
- [listSaasPlans](http/fleet/listsaasplans.md): GET /v1/saas/plans
- [performCloudBoxAction](http/cloud/performcloudboxaction.md): POST /v1/cloud/boxes/{boxId}/action
- [startAgentJob](http/jobs/startagentjob.md): POST /v1/agent-jobs
- [startGithubJob](http/jobs/startgithubjob.md): POST /v1/github-jobs
- [startProjectJob](http/jobs/startprojectjob.md): POST /v1/jobs
- [syncCloudBoxVault](http/cloud/synccloudboxvault.md): POST /v1/cloud/boxes/{boxId}/vault
- [updateOrganizationFleetPolicy](http/fleet/updateorganizationfleetpolicy.md): PUT /v1/organizations/{orgId}/fleet/policy
- [upsertOrganizationMember](http/fleet/upsertorganizationmember.md): POST /v1/organizations/{orgId}/members
